title: An explicit non-elementary matrix over a bivariate Laurent polynomial ring
summary: Let $F$ be the fraction field of a discrete valuation ring. We give an explicit matrix in $\mathrm{SL}_2(F[X^{\pm1},Y^{\pm1}])\setminus \mathrm{E}_2(F[X^{\pm1},Y^{\pm1}])$. The proof of non-elementarity is based on techniques developed by Peter Abramenko in his preprint arXiv:0808.1095v1.
